_comment: Expectation manifest for loom's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern). MUST exit 0 or 1.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file.

mutations.why: nesting #bar back inside #canvas is the original defect — React clears its mount target, $('save') is null, and the whole approval editor dies on first render
the same failure reached from the other side — moving the mount up to #app swallows every wired element without touching the markup
a gate told to "Fix every ... and commit" must be caught — that prompt is what suppressed the back-edge 0/3
mutations.find: ADJUDICATE ONLY. Do not fix anything, do not edit files, do not commit.
mutations.replace: Fix every Critical and High finding, keep the build green, and commit.

mutations.why: same regression in the lite seed must not slip through
mutations.find: ADJUDICATE ONLY. Do not fix anything, do not edit files, do not commit.
mutations.replace: Fix every Critical and High finding, keep the build green, and commit.

mutations.why: dropping `findings` back out of required makes the carry optional again — an empty back-edge payload
same regression in the lite seed must not slip through
dropping the disjointness rule lets two branches share a node — two workers racing it, and visit accounting that cannot be per-branch
dropping the one-exit rule lets a branch escape the region and walk the rest of the graph concurrently with its own sibling
dropping the gate-in-branch rule readmits a mustCross gate that guards one branch while its sibling reaches the terminal without it
letting a fork edge carry a predicate breaks the every-branch-always-runs premise the whole dominance argument rests on
awaiting each branch in turn produces an identical trace, result and visit counts — the feature becomes decorative while every structural check stays green
mutations.find:
const outs = await parallel(branches.map((e, i) => () =>
        walk(e.to, n.join, branchVisits[i], true).then((res) => ({ entry: e.to, res }))))

mutations.why: parallel() resolves a dead thunk to null rather than rejecting, so removing the guard silently crosses the join with a branch missing and reports the run complete
flat-merging the branch carries lets one branch silently overwrite another's field, and the join can no longer tell which branch reported what
reverting the terminal edge to when:"always" is the original defect — a blocked delivery reporting `complete`
dropping `delivered` from required lets the node omit its verdict entirely
